records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Group set up
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no reply to three outreach emails (email:76735d0d, email:5d825bb7, email:3027ec3e), no-show on the onboarding call (calendar:f3a08c3c), no tickets, no project or invite. Silent accounts rarely self-activate in 8 days, though an active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: Getting your first Timber Group project going
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

I know a new tool is easy to put off, so I'll keep this brief. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Once that's in place, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to set up a short call this week and walk through your first project with you -- just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
